meta.name: The Western Desert
meta.note: Approximate reconstruction of a front that swung 1,500 km back and forth twice in fifteen months. Only the coastal strip is contested: the desert south of it is empty, so the theater is drawn as a band along the coast rather than the whole Sahara.

keyframes.label: Italy invades Egypt from Libya, advances 100 km to Sidi Barrani, and stops to build forts.
Three months of nothing. The Italians have dug in at Sidi Barrani since September.
Operation Compass. Two British divisions attack ten Italian ones and do not stop for two months.
Beda Fomm. The Italian Tenth Army is destroyed: 130,000 prisoners for 500 Commonwealth dead. Libya is nearly lost — and then half the army is sent to Greece.
Rommel attacks at El Agheila, against his orders.
Rommel arrives and drives straight back east. Everything is retaken in a fortnight except Tobruk, which is surrounded and held.
Operation Battleaxe fails. The line settles on the Egyptian frontier for five months.
Operation Crusader. The Eighth Army fights its way through to relieve Tobruk after 241 days.
Rommel withdraws to El Agheila, back where he started. The whole year has been a round trip.
